<h1 class="profile-name">Elvis Kwame Ofori</h1>

<div class="profile-role">Researcher, writer and policy observer</div>

<p class="profile-lead">I am Ghanaian, spent several years in China for graduate study, and now live and work in Ireland. I write about public policy, economics, science, technology, agriculture and food, Ghana and Africa, Ireland, the United States, books, research life, and whatever else seems worth thinking through carefully.</p>
